#히밥 #히밥먹방 #라면먹방 

🍜 오늘의 야식 먹방 : 까르보 사리곰탕 라면

오늘은 한 번 먹으면 계속 생각나는

1. 팬에 올리브유를 두르고 양파, 마늘을 먼저 볶아 향을 낸다.
2. 베이컨을 넣고 노릇하게 구워준다.
3. 우유 600ml와 분말스프 1개를 넣고 끓인다.
4. 슬라이스치즈 1장을 넣어 크림 베이스를 만든다.
5. 라면 2개를 넣고 들었다 놨다 하며 쫄깃하게 끓인다.
6. 청양고추, 후추, 후레이크를 넣어 마무리한다.
7. 불 끄고 피자치즈 올려 녹이면 완성🧀

6. 취향에 따라 브로콜리, 홍고추, 팽이버섯, 대파 등 고명을 올려 완성!

en-US.title: I could eat 10 packs of ramen like this #Hibab #Ramen #LateNightSnack
en-US.description:
🍜 Today's Late-Night Mukbang: Master of Life Ramen

Today, I tried making a ramen recipe that feels just like a master's dish, easy to follow at home! 🔥

📌 Master Ramen Recipe

1. Once the water in the pot boils, add the ramen soup base and noodles together and cook.

2. When the noodles have loosened up a bit, add 1/2 tablespoon of anchovy fish sauce to enhance the umami flavor.

3. When the noodles are cooked al dente, drain them and place them in a bowl first.

4. Beat one egg and add it to the boiling broth to cook it slightly.

5. Pour the fluffy egg mixture over the noodles.

6. Add toppings such as broccoli, red chili peppers, enoki mushrooms, or green onions according to your preference to finish!

📌 One-line Review

“One spoonful of anchovy fish sauce completely changes the depth of the broth…”

🍜 Today's Late-Night Mukbang – Radish and Green Onion Ramen

Today, I tried making Radish and Green Onion Ramen, which is appealing for its refreshing and deep broth!

📌 Radish and Green Onion Ramen Recipe

Prepare by thinly slicing the radish and finely chopping the green onions.

Sauté sesame oil, minced garlic, salted shrimp paste, and radish in a pan.

Boil 600ml of water in a pot, then add the sautéed radish.

Once the water boils, add the noodles and soup base and cook for about 4 minutes.

Finally, add the green onions and finish 🍜

🍜 Today's Late-Night Mukbang – Choi Kang-rok Ramen

Today, I tried making and eating Choi Kang-rok Ramen, which is full of soft and savory charm!

📌 Choi Kang-rok Ramen Recipe

Beat the eggs in advance and prepare them separately.

Bring water to a boil in a pot, then add the soup base first.

Add the ramen noodles and boil for about 4 minutes.

Once the noodles are cooked, turn off the heat.

Pour in the prepared beaten eggs, stir well, and let them cook using the residual heat.

Once the eggs are softly mixed, it's done! 🍳🍜

📌 One-line Review

“The broth is much softer and savory, giving it a completely different taste from regular ramen!”
